dialogue_texts: Yukari
My birthplace Mayohiga... it's been quite some time.
Yukari
The boundaries here feel unusually rigid today, as if the village itself is holding its breath.
Well, if it's not Queen Yukari of Western Gensokyo...
Yukari
Uh, excuse me, but when you address royalty, the correct way is "Your Majesty".
Oh, whoops. Didn't realize that. Thanks for reminding me.
To what do we owe the honor of a royal visit to our humble village?
Yukari
I am tracking a certain "glohm" substance that threatens the balance of the kingdoms.
Yukari
It's a dirty problem, and I intend to sweep it away.
"Glohm," you say? If that filth tries to settle here, I'll purify every last drop of it.
Koko
A shrine maiden's duty is to keep her home clean, after all.
Yukari
A kitsune acting as a shrine maiden... How delightful.
Yukari
I wonder if your "purification" can handle a true queen's standards.
Koko
You look a bit tense from all that royal posturing, my Majesty.
Yukari
While I'm here, what do you want to do?
Koko
How about a little "training" to loosen those boundaries of yours?
Yukari
I suppose a brief demonstration of power is in order. Show me your best ritual.
Koko
Let the morning sun and I burn away those royal doubts!
